statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-32178 (GHSA-vmwf-m9c5-3jvc) is a .NET spoofing issue in System.Net.Mail: specially crafted data lets a network attacker spoof content. Microsoft lists the Linux runtime packs among the affected packages and fixed .NET 9 in 9.0.15 (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-vmwf-m9c5-3jvc, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.15/9.0.15.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: System.Net.Mail.dll ships in the .NET shared framework in dotnet9-runtime, in the SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and in the runtime and ILCompiler NuGet packages in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts, and every implementation copy in a build carries that build's .NET version. In 9.0.12-r0 through 9.0.14-r0 System.Net.Mail is 9.0.12 through 9.0.14, which are affected; from 9.0.15-r0 on, the version is 9.0.15 or later, with Microsoft's fix. The range ends at 9.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
